profile.constituencyprofile_Text:
Gudur Assembly Constituency, located in Tirupati district, covers five mandals Gudur, Chillakur, Kota, Vakadu, and Chittamur, with Gudur town as its headquarters. Spanning 1,273.92 sq. km, it is a mix of urban and rural areas, well connected by National Highway-16, a busy railway junction, and close to Krishnapatnam Port. The region has fertile alluvial soils, supported by irrigation projects like Telugu Ganga and Swarnamukhi Barrage, making it a hub for paddy, lemon, and aquaculture. About 65% of the land is under agriculture, and the coastal belt supports fisheries. The constituency also has a rich cultural heritage, with ancient temples like Alaganadha Swamy Temple and Subrahmanya Swamy Temple.


Economically, Gudur contributes strongly to agriculture (46.6% of income) while industry and services sectors are steadily growing with major industries like Nelcast Ltd and Tirumala Milk Products. With a population of around 3 lakh, including significant SC (32.7%) and ST (14.3%) communities, it has a literacy rate of 65%. The area has good social infrastructure with schools, colleges, healthcare centers, and welfare hostels. However, challenges remain in irrigation efficiency, healthcare, and economic diversification. With proper planning under the Vision 2024–29, Gudur can become a model constituency for balanced growth in agriculture, industry, services, and tourism.

economy_text.economy_Text:
Economy at a Glance

Gudur’s economy is driven by agriculture, industry, and services, with key thrust sectors including fishing & aquaculture (22.1% GCVA contribution), manufacturing (19.75%), and agriculture overall (39.6%). The coastal belt supports strong marine exports, while fertile lands enable paddy and lemon cultivation.

Major opportunities lie in developing shipbuilding and shipbreaking SEZs at Duggarajapatnam, leveraging its strategic coastal location for marine industries. The upcoming food processing parks focusing on  seafood will boost agro-industry growth. Industrial expansion is further supported by VCIC development and MSME cluster strengthening.

Excellent connectivity to National Highways ( NH-16), railways, Chennai, and Krishnapatnam Port  enhances trade and logistics, positioning Gudur as a key hub for sustainable growth in agriculture, manufacturing, and marine sectors.
economy_text.gcdP_Growth_Text: Gudur is experiencing steady economic progress with a targeted 15% annual GCDP growth rate, driven by key sectors such as  manufacturing, marine exports, food processing, and emerging shipbuilding and shipbreaking industries. This growth supports the long-term vision of transforming the constituency into a sustainable and thriving industrial and agricultural hub by 2047.

thrust.description: Marine and inland fish farming with modern technology and export focus.
Establishment of food processing units, packaging industries, and food parks with backward linkages to farmers.
Support for MSMEs and large manufacturers across sectors through enabling industrial policies.
Promotion of shipyards, shipbuilding units, and repair docks.
Development of SEZs and VCIC / HBIC / CBIC corridors with infrastructure and tax incentives.
